definitions.root: Joint0 pelvis, translation subtraction only; world heading retained
definitions.position: Mean Euclidean joint error after subtracting each motion own pelvis position per frame.
definitions.velocity: RMS Euclidean finite-difference relative velocity error at20Hz, sensor joints only.
definitions.spread: RMS temporal deviation from each sensor joint own clip mean.
definitions.static_dynamic: Relative position squared RMSE = squared temporal mean-error RMS + squared demeaned-error RMS.
definitions.global_local: Global observed-position MSE = root MSE + relative position MSE + signed2*mean(root error dot local error).
definitions.reduction: Each complete clip equal weight, configurations/populations separate; all matched comparisons use identical8val sources.
definitions.amplitude_ratio: Per-clip predicted/GT relative spread or speed; GT<=1e-12 omitted with explicit denominator, no success gate.
